harness.name: PentAGI
harness.whatItDid: Named by Anthropic as a framework both groups used. One stole production AI API keys; the other dumped European political databases. Google saw most PentAGI activity stop at scanning, but some reach intrusion and persistence at multiple organizations.

uses.quote: The majority of observed PentAGI activity remained at the stage of WHOIS asset mapping or active vulnerability scanning.
However, analysis of operational artifacts indicates that some operations progressed to active intrusions and persistence across multiple organizations.
